name: green-marker-at-price
note: plotshape + location.absolute + price=. Pine's location.absolute places the glyph AT a value rather than above or below the bar -- the shape the ICT suite's liquidity-pivot circles need, since they sit on the pivot price, not on the candle. `location.absolute` already lowered to position 'atPrice', but nothing populated `price`, so the renderer's atPrice branch (which requires price !== undefined) fell through to the mid-bar case and the glyph drew at (open+close)/2. Here the marker fires on every bar and must carry the sampled `high` as its price -- 12, 11, 13, 14 -- NOT the bar midpoint.
source:
indicator("H", shorttitle="H", overlay=true)
plotshape(true, "Pivot", shape=shape.circle, location=location.absolute, price=high, color=color.red, size=size.small)
